summary: DeFi Technologies Inc., a Delaware-incorporated, Toronto-based finance/crypto-assets issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim condensed consolidated financial statements, MD&A and CEO/CFO certifications for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The exhibit index shows only Exhibits 99.1-99.4 (statements, MD&A, Form 52-109F2 certifications), signed by Corporate Secretary Philippe Lucet on November 12, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are stated. Amounts appear in Canadian dollars. This is a routine periodic-reporting filing, not a special situation; watch for subsequent transaction disclosures rather than arbitrage angles.
